title: FileBackup configuration (SR-042)
description: Versioned JSON configuration contract for FileBackup.ps1 -ConfigPath. Published as documentation/editor support; the hand-rolled PowerShell validator in Modules/FileBackup.Engine.psm1 (Import-BackupConfiguration) is the runtime authority. TC-077 pins the two against one fixture corpus so this file cannot drift from the validator. CLIXML configs are the unversioned legacy native-Windows form and are not covered by this schema.

ConfigVersion.description: Currently 2 (version 1 documents are refused as too old: v2 removed PreserveFolderTree — storage is always content-addressed — and added BrowseView/ViewPath). A config declaring a higher version is refused by this build. JSON has one number type, so an integral-valued number IS that integer: 2.0 is accepted as 2 (both by this const and by the runtime validator); 2.5, 0, "2", 1 and anything above 2 are refused.

BackupSets.description: One or more backup sets. An array of at least one set object, or -- matching the runtime validator, which wraps it -- a single bare set object.

CompressProbe.description: Optional; defaults to 'always'. How the stored form is decided when CompressEnabled is true (SR-081): 'off' uses the already-compressed extension list alone (the pre-WP17 behaviour); 'excluded-extensions' keeps the list's exemptions and measures everything it would otherwise compress; 'always' measures every file above the 256 KiB floor, the list serving only the smaller tail. Exact lowercase; ConfigVersion stays 2 because the key is optional and defaulted.

BrowseView.description: Optional; defaults to 'off'. 'index' generates a browsable, manifest-derived INDEX.tsv + per-folder HTML view outside the backup root. 'link' is reserved and refused by name.

ViewPath.description: Optional; defaults to '<BackupPath>_View'. Must lie outside the backup and change roots and on the backup volume. Only meaningful with BrowseView 'index'.

SourceStatePath.description: Optional; defaults to SourcePath. Required in practice for a read-only container source.

AllowEmptySource.description: Optional; defaults to false. Set true only for an intentional delete-all.

secrets.description: Secrets.Credential is intentionally NOT a listed property: JSON cannot carry a PSCredential, and additionalProperties:false rejects it. Containerized runs are -NoMail.
